seed: The right panel reads top to bottom the way the user expects (the user, 2026-10-18: "the panes are totally confusing!!!! layers isn't at the top, i can't drag the pane up and down, library was expanded by default. I think for image editing it should be hidden. And this weird ux with the undo icon when i toggle a pane on?"). At Next defaults with no flag set, in a picture: Layers is on top and fills the panel with nothing picked; a picked layer's sections come under it with no gap; the divider between them drags and is remembered for the next picture; the Library is absent until turned on, and design work turning it on does not leave it open in a picture; the Sections list has plain switches with no circular reset arrow.

steps.comment: Nothing picked: Layers is the whole panel, no Library.

steps.note: Nothing picked: Layers on top and alone, no Library

steps.comment: A picked layer: Layers on top, then its sections, and the pane hugs its four rows so Appearance meets it.

steps.note: A layer picked: Layers, the divider, then Appearance and Effects

steps.comment: Six layers: more than the pane's share, so the divider has room to move.
Remembered: a fresh picture opens with the divider where it was left.

steps.note: A new picture: the divider is where it was left

steps.comment: Design work opens the Library; back in Image it stays hidden.

steps.note: In Design the Library is shown, last, under the pick

steps.comment: Turned on from the Sections list: a plain switch, no circular reset arrow beside it.

steps.note: The Sections list with the Library switched on: no reset arrow
The Library switched on in a picture: last, under the picked layer's sections
